photos.c: Peter Lloyd has had an outstanding Cross Country season

Stars of the future in action at the Club Championships. Ross Bentley (15) and Peter Lloyd (35) storm away from the 400 metre start. Both ended up as winners because Ross is a Colt and Peter a Boy, and both races were combined.
Above: Peter Lloyd picked up many valuable points and was our top ranking Boy 800 metre runner in 1992 in spite of a nagging leg injury.
